brv_wh_delivery_odirath.m: Yes, indeed. A gift for my beautiful daughter... but why did it take so long? Sigh, here's my delivery fee.

odirath_0.m: Welcome to my shop. Are you looking for anything in particular?
r: Please show me everything you have available.
I am looking for my brother, Andor. Have you seen anyone recently that looks a bit like me?
Can you tell me anything about Stoutford?
Did you really order such an ugly porcelain figure? Oops, sorry I didn't mean to offend you.
I have tried to open the southern castle gate, but the mechanism seems broken. Can you repair it?

odirath_1.m: I did see someone that might have been your brother. He was with a rather dubious looking person. They didn't stay around here very long though. Sorry, but that's all I can tell you. You should ask around town. Other townsfolk may know more.
r: Thanks. I'll go and do that now.
Please show me what you have to trade.
OK. Can you tell me anything about Stoutford?

odirath_1_1.m: Stoutford is a small town, and life used to be easy here. A lot of traders stayed in Stoutford on their way to and from Blackwater mountain, and spent money that boosted the economy of the whole town. Those days are gone though.

odirath_1_2.m: The path to Blackwater mountain was cut off by a rock fall. That stopped most of the traders from coming here. The attacks by the monsters stopped the rest.
r: How do I get to Blackwater mountain?

odirath_1_3.m: Just follow the path west, but you will have to find a way past the rockfall.
r: Thanks for the directions. I'm headed there right now.
Thanks for the information. Please show me what you have to trade.

odirath_1_4.m: They started attacking the town recently. Nobody is sure why. Their attacks have been unsuccessful, so we are all hoping that they will give up soon and go back to wherever they came from.
r: Thanks for the information, but I have to leave.
Thanks for the information. Do you have anything to trade?
Thanks. I'm looking for my brother, Andor. Has anyone new been through here recently?
How do I get to Blackwater mountain?

odirath_2.m: Yes, indeed. My daughter has not come home for some days. I don't know what's happened to her.
r: And you have no idea where she might be?

odirath_2_1.m: I've been looking for her all over Stoutford. She does not leave the city. So she can only be in the castle, or kidnapped, or worse.
r: Did you already look for her in the castle?

odirath_2_2.m: You cannot go to the castle anymore, do not you know that? At least not if you want to continue living.
r: I see. She will certainly reappear soon. In the meantime you could show me everything you have for sale.
I am also looking for someone: my brother, Andor. Have you seen anyone recently that looks a bit like me?
OK. Can you tell me anything about Stoutford?
I'm not afraid. I could have a look in the castle.

odirath_2_3.m: You would do that for me? I can hardly accept your offer.
r: No problem, but first I have something else I wish to discuss.

odirath_3_3.m: Gyra is back and has told me everything. Many thanks again for your help.
r: I was happy to do it.

odirath_3_5.m: Please give the helmet to its owner Lord Bourbon - eh, Lord Berbane I mean. He will be in the tavern.
r: I did that already. But he didn't seem to be happy about it.
I did that already. Although he won't need it, because the castle is already clear of the undead.

odirath_8a.m: No, sorry. As long as there are still skeletons running around the castle, I can't work there.

odirath_8b.m: I can do that as soon as my daughter is back here.

odirath_8c.m: The gate mechanism is broken? No problem. Now that the skeletons are gone, I can fix it for you.

stoutford_castle.5: I tried to free this castle from the undead Lord Erwyn. But whenever I kill him, he reappears. I should seek help...
stoutford_castle.10: I talked to Yolgen, the Shadow priest of Stoutford, and he told me that the mighty Lord Erwyn used to reside here, but Lord Erwyn and his army were crushed during a war, the castle was sacked and the house extinguished. But recently Erwyn's knights have risen from the dead. Yolgen asked me to rid Stoutford of these undead once and for all.
stoutford_castle.12: I should ask Tahalendor for some special artifact that I can use to defeat powerful undead.
stoutford_castle.14: Tahalendor gave me a pair of special coins that I can use to defeat powerful undead.
stoutford_castle.16: I slew Lord Erwyn himself and ensured that he remains dead now.
stoutford_castle.20: I slew all the undead knights.
stoutford_castle.42: Among his remains I found a strange ring. I should show it to Yolgen.
stoutford_castle.50: Yolgen examined the ring thoroughly. He suspects it has somehow come from Mt. Galmore and reanimated the long dead soldiers. I should be wary of the evil grasp of Mt. Galmore and whatever lurks there...
stoutford_castle.60: I kept the ring for myself, which upset Yolgen. I should keep looking for its previous owner.
stoutford_castle.70: I kept the ring for myself and didn't tell Yolgen about it. He was suspicious but couldn't do anything about it. I should keep looking for its previous owner.

stn_quest_gyra: Lost girl looking for lost things

stn_quest_gyra.5: The mechanism of the south gate seemed to be broken. Maybe someone in Stoutford could repair it?
stn_quest_gyra.10: The little daughter of Odirath the armorer has been missing for several days now. You offered to help search for her.
stn_quest_gyra.20:
Odirath's daughter Gyra was hidden in the storeroom of the main house of the castle. She was surprised by the raid on the castle and no longer dared to leave her hiding place.
She was looking for Lord Berbane's helmet, which he had forgotten somewhere in the castle.
stn_quest_gyra.30: You offered Gyra to lead her back home safely.
stn_quest_gyra.40: Gyra has the feeling that the helmet is very close.
stn_quest_gyra.60: Once back in Stoutford Gyra knew the way and ran to her father Odirath.
stn_quest_gyra.70: Odirath thanks you many thousand times.
stn_quest_gyra.80: Odirath had repaired the mechanism of the southern castle gate.
stn_quest_gyra.90: Lord Berbane slowly took his helmet. Nevertheless, he remained sitting at the table. He probably needs a few more hours without drinks before he can get back to work. If ever.
stn_quest_gyra.92: Lord Berbane took his helmet. But somehow that does not really satisfy you.
stn_quest_gyra.99: Lord Berbane is singing merrily about his pretended heroic deeds. What a boaster.
stn_quest_gyra.170: Odirath thanked you many thousands of times.
stn_quest_gyra.199: Lord Berbane is singing merrily about his pretended heroic deeds. What a boaster.

brv_wh_delivery.10: Facutloni asked me to help him deliver all of the items ordered by his customers a long time ago. He even gave me an old document with the names and items written on it.
brv_wh_delivery.20: Arcir the Fallhaven book-lover ordered a 'Dusty Old book'.
brv_wh_delivery.30: Edrin the Brimhaven metalsmith ordered a 'Striped Hammer'.
brv_wh_delivery.40: Odirath the Stoutford armorer ordered a 'Pretty Porcelain Figure'.
brv_wh_delivery.50: Venanra the Brimhaven laundress ordered an 'Old, worn cape'.
brv_wh_delivery.60: Tjure the unlucky Brimhaven merchant ordered a 'Mysterious green something'.
brv_wh_delivery.70: Servant the Guynmart servant ordered a 'Chandelier'.
brv_wh_delivery.80: Arghes at Remgard tavern ordered 'Yellow boots'.
brv_wh_delivery.90: Wyre the mournful Vilegard woman ordered a 'Lyre'.
brv_wh_delivery.110: Pangitain the Brimhaven fortune teller ordered a 'Crystal Globe'.
brv_wh_delivery.120: Facutloni wants me to report back after the deliveries are complete.
brv_wh_delivery.130: I reported back to Facutloni. He is very happy.
